request.query: Hasse Schmidt divided partial derivatives injective variable substitution Taylor coefficients

items.name: MvPolynomial.pderiv_rename
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type v} [inst : CommSemiring R] {τ : Type u_1} {f : σ → τ},
  Function.Injective f →
    ∀ (x : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R),
      (MvPolynomial.pderiv (f x)) ((MvPolynomial.rename f) p) = (MvPolynomial.rename f) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv x) p)

items.name: Polynomial.taylor_injective
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Ring R] (r : R), Function.Injective ⇑(Polynomial.taylor r)

items.name: Polynomial.taylor_coeff
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  ((Polynomial.taylor r) f).coeff n = Polynomial.eval r ((Polynomial.hasseDeriv n) f)

items.name: PowerSeries.subst
items.type:
{R : Type u_2} →
  [inst : CommRing R] →
    {τ : Type u_3} →
      {S : Type u_4} → [inst_1 : CommRing S] → [Algebra R S] → MvPowerSeries τ S → PowerSeries R → MvPowerSeries τ S

items.name: MvPowerSeries.coeff_subst
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] {τ : Type u_4} {S : Type u_5} [inst_1 : CommRing S]
  [inst_2 : Algebra R S] {a : σ → MvPowerSeries τ S},
  MvPowerSeries.HasSubst a →
    ∀ (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) (e : τ →₀ ℕ),
      (MvPowerSeries.coeff e) (MvPowerSeries.subst a f) =
        ∑ᶠ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f • (MvPowerSeries.coeff e) (d.prod fun s e => a s ^ e)
